definitions.explanation: A person skilled in swordsmanship. Can refer to historical swordsmen, modern kendo practitioners, or fictional sword-wielding characters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧{剣士|けんし}だ。
{若|わか}い{剣士|けんし}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{競|きそ}い{合|あ}った→競い合う：04656_kisoiau⟧。
examples.english: Young fencers competed against each other in the tournament.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧⟦{伝説|でんせつ}→伝説：11446_densetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{剣士|けんし}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいる→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I'm reading a book about legendary swordsmen who left their mark on history.

notes:
{剣士|けんし} refers to a person skilled in sword fighting. It is used across historical, modern martial arts, and fictional contexts.

FORMS:
⟦{剣|けん}→剣：11819_ken⟧ (sword) + ⟦{士|し}→〜士：28352_shi⟧ (person, practitioner)

USAGE:
- Historical: samurai and sword masters of feudal Japan
- Modern: ⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧ (kendo) practitioners and fencers
- Fiction: a common character class in anime, manga, and games

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{凄腕|すごうで}→凄腕：07300_sugoude⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{剣士|けんし}: a highly skilled swordsman
- ⟦{伝説|でんせつ}→伝説：11446_densetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{剣士|けんし}: a legendary swordsman
- ⟦{女|おんな}→女：00559_onna⟧{剣士|けんし}: a female swordsman
- ⟦{最強|さいきょう}→最強：13073_saikyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{剣士|けんし}: the strongest swordsman

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧: kendo (the way of the sword)
- ⟦{剣術|けんじゅつ}→剣術：20194_kenjutsu⟧: swordsmanship, sword technique
- {剣|つるぎ} / ⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧: sword
- ⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧: warrior, samurai
- ⟦{侍|さむらい}→侍：10499_samurai⟧: samurai
